seoTitle: How to Search Nifty Options in TradingView Correctly
metaDescription: Learn how to search Nifty options in TradingView, filter CE and PE contracts, choose the right strike and expiry, and avoid opening the wrong contract.
intro: Finding the exact Nifty option contract you want in TradingView can be tricky if you're not familiar with the symbol format. This guide walks through searching for CE and PE contracts, selecting the correct strike price and expiry date, and verifying you've opened the right one. It's aimed at Nifty and options traders who want to avoid costly mix-ups.

steps.heading: Open symbol search
steps.body: Click the symbol search bar in TradingView to begin looking for Nifty option contracts.

steps.heading: Type the Nifty option format
steps.body: Enter the Nifty option symbol format, including the underlying index, expiry, strike price, and option type.

steps.heading: Select the strike and expiry
steps.body: Choose the specific strike price and expiry date that matches the contract you intend to analyze or trade.

steps.heading: Filter CE and PE contracts
steps.body: Narrow your search results by call (CE) or put (PE) options depending on which type of contract you're looking for.

steps.heading: Verify the correct contract
steps.body: Double-check the symbol details on the chart to confirm you've opened the exact strike, expiry, and option type you intended.

faq.question: What does CE and PE mean in Nifty options?
faq.answer: CE stands for Call European option and PE stands for Put European option, representing the two basic types of option contracts.

faq.question: Why is it easy to open the wrong Nifty option contract?
faq.answer: The symbol format includes expiry date, strike price, and option type packed closely together, so a small mistake in reading it can lead to selecting the wrong contract.

faq.question: Can I search Nifty options by strike price directly?
faq.answer: Yes, once you start typing the Nifty option symbol, TradingView typically shows a list you can filter by strike price and expiry.

faq.question: How do I confirm I've selected the right contract before trading?
faq.answer: Check the full symbol details shown on the chart, including expiry date, strike price, and CE or PE designation, before placing any trade.
